title: Non-target analysis of crude oil photooxidation products at high latitudes and their biological effects.
authors: Redman, Zachary C; Robine, Sage; Burkhead, Jason; Tomco, Patrick L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究原油光氧化产物的非靶向化学分析与生物效应，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: With new oil and gas lease sales in high-latitude regions, there exists a need to better understand the chemical fate of spilled oil and its effects on biological life. To address this need, laboratory simulations of crude oil spills under sub-Arctic conditions were conducted using artificial seawater and exposure to solar irradiation to create Hydrocarbon Oxidation Products (HOPs). HOPs characterization and their biological effects were assessed using ultra high-performance liquid chromatography (UHPLC) with high resolution mass Orbitrap spectrometry and the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) chemically activated luciferase gene expression (CALUX) assay. Non-target UHPLC-Orbitrap mass spectrometry analysis identified 251 HOPs that were in greater abundance in light-exposed samples than dark controls. Oxidized polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons were also detected, including phenanthrene quinone, anthraquinone, hydroxyanthraquinone, and 9-fluoreneone. The composition of HOPs were consistent with photo-products of alkylated two to four ring PAHs, primarily compounds between 1 and 3 aromatic rings and 1-3 oxygens. The HOP mixture formed during photochemical weathering of Cook Inlet crude oil induced greater AhR activity than parent petroleum products solubilized in dark controls, indicating that HOPs, as a complex mixture, may contribute to petroleum toxicity more than the parent petroleum compounds. These non-targeted approaches provide the most comprehensive analysis of hydrocarbon oxidation products to date, highlighting the diversity of the complex mixture resulting from the photooxidation of crude oil and the limitations of targeted analyses for adequately monitoring HOPs in the environment. Taken together, these data identify a critical "blind spot" in environmental monitoring and spill clean-up strategies as there is a diverse pool of HOPs that may negatively impact human and ecosystem health.
abstract_zh: 随着高纬度地区新增油气租赁销售，亟需更深入地了解泄漏石油的化学归宿及其对生物生命的影响。为满足这一需求，在亚北极条件下进行了原油泄漏的实验室模拟，使用人工海水并暴露于太阳辐射以生成烃类氧化产物（HOPs）。采用超高效液相色谱（UHPLC）结合高分辨率质谱Orbitrap检测及芳烃受体（AhR）化学激活荧光素酶基因表达（CALUX）试验，评估了HOPs的特性及其生物效应。非靶向UHPLC-Orbitrap质谱分析鉴定出251种HOPs，在光照样品中的丰度高于暗对照。还检测到氧化多环芳烃，包括菲醌、蒽醌、羟基蒽醌和9-芴酮。HOPs的组成与烷基化二至四环多环芳烃的光产物一致，主要为含1至3个芳香环和1至3个氧原子的化合物。在库克湾原油光化学风化过程中形成的HOP混合物诱导的AhR活性高于暗对照中溶解的母体石油产品，表明HOPs作为复杂混合物，其对石油毒性的贡献可能超过母体石油化合物。这些非靶向方法提供了迄今为止对烃类氧化产物最全面的分析，突显了原油光氧化产生的复杂混合物的多样性，以及靶向分析在充分监测环境中HOPs方面的局限性。综合来看，这些数据揭示了环境监测和泄漏清理策略中的一个关键“盲区”，因为存在多样化的HOPs库，可能对人类和生态系统健康产生负面影响。
